memory_candidates.content: When modifying general-implementation-agent.md, always apply identical edits to all 4 copies (.opencode/agent/subagents/, .opencode/extensions/core/agents/, .claude/agents/, .claude/extensions/core/agents/). The .claude copies have 1 extra blank line at the start (line 30), so sed/grep offsets differ by 1 but content is identical. Verify with diff on relevant sections, not just line counts.

Plan file checklist syntax convention: Use `- [ ] **Task {P}.{N}**: {description}` format within phase Tasks sections. Agents convert `- [ ]` to `- [x]` during implementation, optionally appending `*(completed: brief note)*`. The JSON progress file remains the primary machine-readable source; plan check-off is human-readable augmentation only.
